title: Narrow and Deep: An Ontology Tower as the Knowledge of an LLM Agent for an Industrial Equipment System
title_zh: Narrow and Deep: An Ontology Tower as the Knowledge of an LLM Agent for an Industrial Equipment System

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM) agents are beginning to operate industrial energy equipment, and what they get right depends on what they are told about the plant. Established building ontologies name many kinds of points across many sites, whereas an industrial equipment system needs few entities with much knowledge about each. This study proposes the ontology tower, a narrow-and-deep ontology of a single equipment system whose knowledge deepens in two ways: through quantities derived from the measured points by physical relations, and through lessons from the operating journal incorporated as knowledge nodes. On a real low-humidity air-handling test plant operated daily through a programmable logic controller, agents received a text projected from its tower in a preregistered evaluation of nine tasks replayed from the plant’s records, using four open-weight models from 9 to about 750 billion parameters. This knowledge raised the rate at which the agents avoided the most plausible misjudgment of each task by about 20 percentage points, and the overall task score of the 9-billion-parameter model as much as that of the largest. Operating lessons were used when incorporated into the tower or placed in the prompt as records, but seldom when left in the journal behind a search tool. In live runs through an invariant safety layer, the agents brought the controlled variable into its target band in 12 of 14 runs. An ontology narrow in entities but deep in what is known about them can thus supply the knowledge that an agent for an industrial equipment system needs.

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM) agents are beginning to take part in operating building and industrial energy equipment: they read process points, diagnose faults, and propose setpoint changes [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 ] . Because plant data are often kept within the operator’s own network, such agents are also being built on open-weight models that run on site [ 5 , 6 ] . In these studies the agent receives one package of knowledge, in which the meaning of the tags, the couplings of the equipment, the procedures, and past incidents enter together, and the package is judged as a whole against a baseline without it [ 7 , 8 ] . However, what the knowledge of a particular plant should contain, and in what form it should reach the agent, has not been measured. Therefore, a structure is needed in which the knowledge of one plant is kept explicitly and can be supplied to an agent in controlled parts.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体已开始参与建筑与工业能源设备的运行：它们读取工艺数据点、诊断故障，并提出设定值调整建议 [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 ] 。 由于工厂数据通常保留在操作员自身的网络内，这类智能体也基于可在现场运行的开放权重模型构建 [ 5 , 6 ] 。 在这些研究中，智能体接收一个知识包，其中标签的含义、设备间的耦合关系、操作规程以及过往事件被整合在一起，并通过与不包含这些知识的基准进行比较来整体评估该知识包 [ 7 , 8 ] 。 然而，特定工厂的知识应包含哪些内容，以及应以何种形式传递到智能体中，这些问题尚未得到明确界定。 因此，需要一种结构，能够将某个工厂的知识以显式方式保存，并能以受控的分块形式提供给智能体。

paragraphs.en: Ontologies are the established way to keep such knowledge. Brick [ 9 ] , SAREF [ 10 ] , the Asset Administration Shell [ 11 ] , and ISO 15926 [ 12 ] define vocabularies that name points and assets across many buildings and plants, so that applications can find them. Agents that query such models through graph retrieval have answered building questions [ 13 ] , supported multi-zone control [ 14 ] , and outperformed agents without a graph-based data layer [ 15 ] . These vocabularies are broad by design: they cover many kinds of equipment with a shallow description of each. An agent that operates one equipment system needs the opposite. The system has few entities, but the agent must know how each value is derived from the measured points, which assumptions it depends on, and what has happened to the system in operation. However, no ontology for equipment states the physical derivations and the operating history of a single system together with its points. Therefore, an ontology that is narrow in its entities and deep in its knowledge is required.
paragraphs.zh: 本体论是保存此类知识的成熟方法。 Brick [ 9 ]、SAREF [ 10 ]、资产管理系统外壳 [ 11 ] 以及 ISO 15926 [ 12 ] 定义了用于命名众多建筑和工厂中各个测点与资产的词汇表，以便应用程序能够找到它们。 通过图检索查询此类模型的智能体已经回答了建筑相关的问题 [ 13 ]、支持了多区域控制 [ 14 ]，并且表现优于没有基于图的数据层的智能体 [ 15 ]。 这些词汇表在设计上范围广泛：它们涵盖了多种类型的设备，但每种设备的描述都较为浅显。 操作单一设备系统的智能体则需要相反的情况。 该系统包含的实体很少，但智能体必须了解每个数值是如何从测点数据中推导出来的、依赖哪些假设，以及系统在运行过程中经历了什么变化。 然而，目前没有任何本体论能够同时描述单个设备的物理推导过程、运行历史及其测点信息。 因此，需要一种在实体范围上较窄、在知识深度上较深的新本体论。

paragraphs.en: How much an agent gains from supplied knowledge may also depend on the model, and the reported results disagree. Retrieval improved smaller models the most in Ren et al. [ 16 ] , and a 14-billion-parameter model with retrieval approached GPT-4 in clinical decision support [ 17 ] . In contrast, Ning et al. [ 18 ] found the largest gain at intermediate sizes, and Pandey [ 19 ] found that models of up to seven billion parameters failed to use retrieved passages even when the passages held the answer. Luong Tuan and Sanyal [ 20 ] attributed the effect of ontology grounding to how well training covered the domain rather than to model size. None of these studies supplied curated knowledge of equipment or concerned a physical plant. Therefore, whether a small open-weight model gains as much as the largest open-weight models from the knowledge of a plant, and whether the form of supply matters, has to be measured on real equipment.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体从所提供的知识中获得的收益可能还取决于模型，而已有研究的结果并不一致。 在 Ren 等人的研究中，检索能力对较小模型的提升最为显著。 [ 16 ]，而一个拥有 140 亿参数的模型在结合检索后，其临床决策支持能力已接近 GPT-4 [ 17 ]。相比之下，Ning 等人 [ 18] 发现中等规模的模型收益最大，而 Pandey [ 19] 则发现，即使检索到的段落包含答案，参数规模高达 70 亿参数的模型仍无法有效利用这些段落。 Luong Tuan 和 Sanyal [ 20] 认为，本体论基础效应取决于训练数据对领域的覆盖程度，而非模型规模。 这些研究中没有任何一项提供了经过筛选的设备知识，或涉及物理设施。 因此，小型开放权重模型能否像最大的开放权重模型一样从工厂知识中获益，以及知识提供的方式是否重要，都必须通过实际设备来验证。

paragraphs.en: A plant also changes while it is operated, and what its operators learn is first written into an operating journal of incidents, investigations, and corrections. Systems that build a knowledge base from operating logs retrieve from it as a step of their procedure [ 3 ] , and the maintenance of an ontology whose content changes over time has been studied as ontology evolution [ 21 , 22 ] . However, whether an agent uses the lessons of operation when they are incorporated into the ontology, compared with when they are left in the journal for the agent to retrieve, has not been tested. Therefore, an ontology for an agent should state how it takes in the lessons of operation, and that choice should be tested within the same tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 植物在运行过程中也会发生变化，而操作员所学到的内容首先会被记录到一份包含事件、调查和纠正措施的运行日志中。 那些从运行日志构建知识库的系统会在其流程中从该知识库检索信息 [ 3 ]，而对内容随时间变化的本体进行维护的问题已被研究为“本体演化” [ 21 , 22 ]。 然而，智能体在将运行经验整合到本体时是否会利用这些经验，与将这些经验保留在日志中供智能体自行检索的情况相比，尚未得到验证。 因此，智能体的本体应明确说明其如何吸收运行经验，并且这一选择应在相同任务中进行测试。

paragraphs.en: In this study, an ontology tower, a narrow-and-deep ontology of a single equipment system, is proposed as the knowledge that an LLM agent receives about a plant, and it is tested on a real low-humidity air-handling test plant operated daily through a programmable logic controller (PLC). To give the ontology depth, quantities derived from the measured points by physical relations are added above the tagged points, with the level of each node computed from its declared dependencies, and lessons from the operating journal are attached to the points they concern as knowledge nodes. To supply it to an agent, a text projected from the tower is placed in the prompt, and every command that the agent issues passes through an invariant safety layer. To evaluate this supply, a preregistered evaluation of reading and diagnosis tasks replayed from the plant’s records was conducted with four open-weight models, together with comparisons of the form in which the knowledge and the operating lessons are supplied. Finally, the agents changed setpoints on the live plant through the safety layer. The evaluation is confined to one plant, and its extension to many similar systems is discussed in Section 4 .
paragraphs.zh: 本研究提出了一种本体论塔，即针对单一设备系统的窄而深的本体论，作为大型语言模型智能体获取关于工厂的知识，并在通过可编程逻辑控制器（PLC）每日运行的真实低湿度空气处理测试工厂中进行了测试。 为增强本体论的深度，在标记点之上添加了通过物理关系从测量点推导出的量值，每个节点的水平由其声明的依赖关系计算得出，并从运行日志中吸取的经验教训则以知识节点的形式附加到相关点上。 为向智能体提供该知识，将从本体论塔中提取的文本置于提示词中，且智能体发出的每条命令都会经过一个不变的安全层。 为评估这一知识供给方式，使用四种开放权重模型对从工厂记录中重演的阅读和诊断任务进行了预先注册的评估，并比较了不同形式的知识与运行经验教训的提供方式。 最后，智能体通过安全层对实际运行的工厂设置了新的设定值。 本次评估仅限于一个工厂，而将其扩展至多个类似系统的讨论见第 4 节。

sents.zh: 本研究提出了一种本体论塔，即针对单一设备系统的窄而深的本体论，作为大型语言模型智能体获取关于工厂的知识，并在通过可编程逻辑控制器（PLC）每日运行的真实低湿度空气处理测试工厂中进行了测试。

sents.en: To give the ontology depth, quantities derived from the measured points by physical relations are added above the tagged points, with the level of each node computed from its declared dependencies, and lessons from the operating journal are attached to the points they concern as knowledge nodes.
sents.zh: 为增强本体论的深度，在标记点之上添加了通过物理关系从测量点推导出的量值，每个节点的水平由其声明的依赖关系计算得出，并从运行日志中吸取的经验教训则以知识节点的形式附加到相关点上。

sents.en: To supply it to an agent, a text projected from the tower is placed in the prompt, and every command that the agent issues passes through an invariant safety layer.
sents.zh: 为向智能体提供该知识，将从本体论塔中提取的文本置于提示词中，且智能体发出的每条命令都会经过一个不变的安全层。

sents.en: To evaluate this supply, a preregistered evaluation of reading and diagnosis tasks replayed from the plant’s records was conducted with four open-weight models, together with comparisons of the form in which the knowledge and the operating lessons are supplied.
sents.zh: 为评估这一知识供给方式，使用四种开放权重模型对从工厂记录中重演的阅读和诊断任务进行了预先注册的评估，并比较了不同形式的知识与运行经验教训的提供方式。

sents.en: Finally, the agents changed setpoints on the live plant through the safety layer.
sents.zh: 最后，智能体通过安全层对实际运行的工厂设置了新的设定值。

sents.en: The evaluation is confined to one plant, and its extension to many similar systems is discussed in Section 4 .
sents.zh: 本次评估仅限于一个工厂，而将其扩展至多个类似系统的讨论见第 4 节。

paragraphs.en: In this section, the ontology tower is presented first: the principle of narrow and deep knowledge, the tower and its height, and the two ways in which its knowledge deepens. The supply of the tower to an agent and the safety layer that bounds the agent’s actions are then described. Finally, the test plant and the three tests are presented: a preregistered evaluation, an experiment on the form of the operating lessons, and live runs on the plant.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，首先介绍本体论塔：窄而深的知识原则、这座塔及其高度，以及其知识深化的两种方式。 接着描述了该塔为智能体提供的供给，以及限制智能体行为的保护层。 最后，介绍了测试工厂和三项测试：预先注册的评估、对操作课程形式的实验，以及对工厂的实际运行测试。

paragraphs.en: An ontology tower covers one equipment system, that is, several machines operated as one unit, such as an air handler with its chiller and desiccant rotor. The number of entities is small, a few dozen measured points and setpoints, but each is described far beyond its name: its binding to the controller, its unit and scale, how it was verified, which quantities are derived from it, which assumptions those derivations depend on, and what the operators have learned about it. Broad vocabularies such as Brick name the points that such a system exposes; the tower stands on those points and holds what an agent needs to reason about this one system.
paragraphs.zh: 一个本体论塔覆盖一个设备系统，即多个作为单一单元运行的机器，例如带冷水机和干燥转子的空气处理机组。 实体的数量很少，只有几十个测量点和设定值，但每个实体都被描述得远不止其名称：它与控制器的绑定关系、其单位和标度、验证方式、哪些量是从它推导出来的、这些推导依赖于哪些假设，以及操作员从中获得了哪些经验。 Brick 等广泛词汇表命名了此类系统暴露出的各个点；本体论塔建立在这些点之上，并包含了智能体推理该单一系统所需的信息。

paragraphs.en: An ontology tower (OntoTower) is thus a narrow-and-deep ontology of a single equipment system: a set of physically grounded tags, assumptions treated as nodes, derived quantities, and knowledge nodes, in which the level of each node is computed from the dependencies declared for it rather than assigned by the modeler.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，本体论塔（OntoTower）是一个针对单一设备系统的狭窄而深入的本体论：它由一组具有物理基础的标签、被视为节点的假设、派生量以及知识节点组成，其中每个节点的水平是根据其声明的依赖关系计算得出的，而非由建模者指定。

paragraphs.en: Fig. 1 shows the tower of the studied system, drawn from its own data. The height of the tower shows how far its knowledge extends above measurement. The bottom stratum, P, is the equipment schematic. The stratum above it, B, binds each tag read from the controller, a named process point of the control system such as a supply-air temperature or a setpoint, to its PLC address, raw scale, unit, and the code that defines it; in the studied tower, 33 of the 42 tags have such a binding. Level 0 holds the tags, the assumptions, and the knowledge nodes, which Fig. 1 draws beside the tower, and every level above it holds what depends on the levels below.

paragraphs.en: The height is computed from declared dependencies; it is neither drawn by hand nor read off the physics. The level of a node is the length of the longest path of dependencies that reaches it from measurement, one step above the deepest of its parents. In a real plant nearly every quantity influences many others, so a dependency edge is drawn only where the plant’s own repository declares a directed relation, and there are three such sources: the inputs of a derivation, a control point and the process variables it is declared to drive, and a causal chain recorded among the couplings of the units. Constraint and coordination relations, such as an upper limit that one controller places on another or the split of airflow between branches, are kept as knowledge and do not become edges, and relations without a natural direction, such as conservation laws, become checks that depend on both sides. A tag therefore rises above level 0 only when such a declaration names it as driven. In the studied tower, 12 of the 42 tags do; the highest is the chamber temperature at level 3, reached through the declared chain from the chilled-water setpoint through the supply-water and supply-air temperatures (Fig. 1 , left). A level thus states how far a value lies from measurement in the declared knowledge, not in the physical field.

paragraphs.en: The first way in which the knowledge deepens is through physics, and it is recorded in the height of the tower. Above the measured points, the tower holds quantities derived through engineering relations, such as psychrometric conversions, mass and energy balances, and fan affinity laws, and each derivation states its inputs, its formula, its unit, and the assumptions it uses. The 16 derived quantities of the studied tower occupy levels 1 to 4, including the two consistency checks at the top. In the right chain of Fig. 1 , the power of the reactivation heater, a measured airflow, and a humidity ratio combine into the specific dehumidification energy. An assumption is anything believed but not measured, such as an atmospheric pressure taken as 1013 hPa or a flow sensor trusted while its re-verification is pending, and it is a node with a statement and a status that changes when the belief is confirmed by measurement. Because every derivation is linked to the assumptions it uses, the tower shows which values rest on each belief: the assumed atmospheric pressure enters four derived quantities, among them the humidity ratio and the specific dehumidification energy, and the two assumptions on the flow sensors enter six. When such an assumption is checked by measurement and found wrong, these are the values to be recomputed. As the description of a system grows, this depth can extend inside the components themselves, for example to the flow within the coil of a heat exchanger, and each such quantity enters the tower as a derivation with its own inputs and assumptions. The ontology thus holds the physics of the system as well as its names.
paragraphs.zh: 知识深化的第一种方式是通过物理学实现的，这一点记录在塔楼的高度中。 在已测量点之上，塔楼包含通过工程关系推导出的量值，例如湿球温度转换、质量与能量平衡以及风机相似定律；每个推导过程都会说明其输入、公式、单位以及所采用的假设。 所研究塔楼的 16 个推导量值占据第 1 至第 4 层，包括顶部的两个一致性检查项。 在图 1 的右侧链中，再激活加热器的功率、一个已测量的气流以及一个湿度比共同构成了单位除湿能量。 假设是指任何被相信但未被测量的内容，例如将大气压视为 1013 hPa，或在重新验证尚未完成时信任某个流量传感器；它是一个带有声明和状态的节点，当该信念通过测量得到证实时，其状态会发生变化。 由于每个推导都与它所依赖的假设相关联，塔楼会显示哪些数值基于每一项信念：假设的大气压影响四个推导量值，其中包括湿度比和单位除湿能量；而关于流量传感器的两个假设则影响六个量值。 当此类假设通过测量被验证为错误时，这些数值就需要重新计算。 随着系统描述的扩展，这种深度还可以延伸至组件内部，例如热交换器线圈内的流动；每个这样的量值都会作为带有自身输入和假设的推导项进入塔楼。 因此，该本体既包含系统的物理特性，也包含其名称。

paragraphs.en: The second way in which the knowledge deepens is through time. A system changes while it is operated, and its operators record incidents, investigations, and corrections in an operating journal. When an incident yields a lesson, for example that a status flag reporting normal operation can hide an abnormal cycle of the desiccant unit, the lesson is written into the tower as a knowledge node linked to the nodes it concerns. The knowledge node kind holds operating lessons, the automatic logic of the equipment, and operating envelopes as text. This depth does not add to the height of the tower: a knowledge node stays at level 0, and its links to the nodes it concerns are not counted in the levels, so it adds to what is known about a point rather than to how far the point lies from measurement. Whenever the tower is extracted, the journal entries written since the previous extraction are incorporated in this way, so the tower is an evolving tower in the sense of ontology evolution [ 21 , 22 ] . A lesson incorporated in this way is specific to the system that produced it, and the tower becomes more specific to its system the longer the system is operated. In the studied plant, this practice preceded the tower: of the four incidents used as diagnosis tasks below, two had their lessons written into the plant’s ontology files when their journal entries were written, and the other two were never incorporated.

paragraphs.en: The agent does not receive the nodes and edges of the tower; it reads a text projected from them. The projection states, in prose and structured blocks, the identity, verification, and known faults of each sensor, the couplings between the units and their automatic logic, the knowledge nodes, and the operating envelopes of the control points, in about 45,000 characters for this plant, and it is placed in the agent’s prompt. The projection is generated from the same descriptive records from which the tower is extracted, namely the plant’s sensor registry, the descriptions of the couplings, the ontology of its control points, and its system targets, so every entry of the projection appears in the tower. The plant keeps its derivations as computations in its monitoring software rather than as descriptions, and the 16 derived quantities and their assumptions are therefore in the tower but not in the projection, and the evaluation tests the tower’s descriptive content (Section 4.3 ). The same knowledge can reach the agent in other forms, which the evaluation compares (Section 2.8 ): the whole tower serialized as JSON (about 99,000 characters), the tower itself offered to the agent as tools, namely three read-only queries with which the agent looks up a node, follows its edges, and lists its assumptions, and the plant’s documents behind a search tool. With the query tools the agent consults the tower directly, so a statement that the agent bases on a query can be traced to the node that the query returned, a property that the text does not have. Fig. 2 shows one diagnosis trial with the query tools, run on the plant’s recorded data. Panel (A) shows the plant, panel (B) the tower with each node that the agent queried marked by the number of the call, and panel (C) the calls in order and a condensed diagnosis, beside whose findings the authors marked the calls that supplied the evidence. The agent made twelve calls, seven to the tower, two of which asked for nodes that do not exist, and five to the plant data.

paragraphs.en: An agent that may change setpoints acts through one write path. Every command passes through an invariant safety layer, the same code in every run, which checks in order whether the tag is on the list allowed for the run, whether the value lies within the permitted range, whether a person has written to the plant recently, and whether the change satisfies the guard that the plant’s software applies to automated setpoint changes: absolute limits, step size, hourly and cumulative change limits, and a waiting time between changes. It then writes the value, reads it back, and records the command, accepted or refused.
paragraphs.zh: 一个可能更改设定点的智能体通过一条写入路径进行作用。 每条命令都会经过一个不变的安全层——每次运行都使用相同的代码——该安全层会按顺序检查：标签是否在该次运行允许列表中，数值是否在允许范围内，最近是否有人向工厂写过数据，以及该变更是否满足工厂软件对自动化设定点变更所施加的限制条件：绝对极限、步长、每小时及累计变更限制，以及变更之间的等待时间。 然后，它会写入该数值，将其读回，并记录该命令是被接受还是被拒绝。

paragraphs.en: The test plant is a low-humidity air-handling system of the kind used for industrial dry rooms. It was designed and built at the authors’ institute with the equipment manufacturers to condition a test chamber, and several research groups use it daily. It is industrial in kind rather than a laboratory model: the desiccant unit, the air-handling unit, and the chiller are commercial equipment run by the plant’s PLC [ 23 ] . Make-up air from the building’s conditioned space is pre-cooled by a packaged unit, mixed with return air from the chamber, and dried in the process sector of a desiccant rotor (Munters ML420, rated at 420 m³/h of process air), whose outlet reaches a frost point near −40 °C. The dried air then splits in a ratio of about two to one. The larger stream passes the air-handling unit, which has a chilled-water coil served by a dedicated precision chiller, four 2.5 kW electric heaters, and an electric humidifier, and returns to the chamber as supply air. The smaller stream is heated electrically to about 130 °C and passed back through the regeneration sector of the rotor before it is exhausted. Dew-point transmitters measure the supply air, the rotor outlet, and the return air, and a fourth inside the chamber reads high and is not used for judgments; thermal mass-flow stations measure the principal air streams, and electric power is metered for each device. The plant’s operating rules prefer the dew-point sensors to the relative humidity sensors, which are unreliable below about 5 % relative humidity, the range in which this plant mostly operates. The operators change setpoints through the plant’s supervisory control software or through the web interface of a server beside the plant, which logs every point at a nominal interval of 15 s and hosts the plant’s LLM assistant.

paragraphs.en: Nine tasks were built from the plant’s records. In the five reading tasks, the agent receives a snapshot of the plant’s display at a fixed time and must interpret specified points, for example a humidity point whose label suggests the wrong location. Each of the four diagnosis tasks is built on a real incident: an abnormal oscillation of the desiccant unit, a self-stop limit cycle of the same unit, a sweep of setpoint changes made from outside the agent’s server, and a stop cascade at low airflow. Each task specifies ground-truth elements with points and trap elements, plausible misjudgments that the data invite. The element score of a trial is the share of the points awarded, which can slightly exceed 1 where a task has a bonus element, and the primary-trap avoidance rate is the share of trials that avoid the task’s first and most plausible misjudgment. The agent worked in an evaluation copy of the plant’s LLM assistant, limited to 60 steps and 1,500 s per trial, with read-only tools for points, values, time series, statistics, and the record of control actions, all cut at the time of the task, and with a general tool for reading files in its workspace. In these tasks the plant’s records were replayed, and control of the live plant was tested separately (Section 2.10 ). Two diagnosis incidents that predate the retention of the time-series database were reconstructed from values in the operating journal.

paragraphs.en: Four open-weight models were evaluated at a sampling temperature of 0.3: Qwen3.5-9B, gemma-4-31B-it, EXAONE-4.5-33B, and GLM-5.2, a mixture-of-experts model with about 750 billion parameters, among the largest and most capable open-weight models at the time of the evaluation. The five cumulative conditions, K4x, K2-sub, K3-sub, and the scrambled-order control comprised 1,304 trials and were preregistered with three hypotheses: H1, that structured knowledge raises the primary-trap avoidance rate; H2, that its gain increases with model capacity; and H3, that the records of the task’s own incident raise the diagnosis score. All other comparisons are exploratory, including those of the two tower conditions, which were added afterwards. Each trial was scored by an LLM judge, gpt-5.6-sol, which received the task’s elements and the agent’s response but not the model or the condition. Agreement between raters was measured with Cohen’s κ, the agreement between two raters corrected for the agreement expected by chance, which is 1 for complete agreement and 0 for agreement at chance level. A second judge, claude-opus-5-5, run in isolation after an earlier second judge was found to have had access to the authors’ notes, agreed with the first on primary-trap avoidance with κ = 0.819 over 121 sampled trials. On seven randomly selected trials on which the two judges agreed, the first author’s verdicts agreed with theirs with κ = 0.696, just below the registered threshold of 0.7. Each hypothesis was tested in a mixed model with a random intercept for the task, with the Holm correction over the three one-sided tests.

paragraphs.en: To test whether a lesson is used because of where it is kept, the lesson of each diagnosis task’s own incident was supplied in three forms within the same task, with everything else in K4 unchanged: incorporated into the tower as a knowledge node, as the journal record placed in the prompt, and as the journal record left in the journal, where the agent could reach it only by searching or opening the documents. In the two tasks whose lessons had been incorporated (Section 2.4 ), the last two forms were made by removing the passages that stated the lesson from the projected text and from its copy among the searchable documents. In the two tasks whose lessons had never been incorporated, the first form was made by adding a knowledge node written from the incident record by a separately run model, which was given the record, the format of a node, and a pointer to the journal entry. The three forms were run on the four diagnosis tasks with the four models and three repetitions, 144 trials in one batch.
paragraphs.zh: 为了测试某一课程是否因其存储位置而被使用，每个诊断任务中对应事件的课程以三种形式出现在同一任务中，而 K4 中的其他所有内容均保持不变：将其作为知识节点整合进塔中，作为提示词中的日志记录，以及作为留在日志中的日志记录，智能体只能通过搜索或打开文档才能访问后者。 在那些课程已被整合的两个任务中（第 2.4 节），最后两种形式是通过从投影文本和可搜索文档中的副本中移除陈述该课程的段落而形成的。 在那些课程从未被整合的两个任务中，第一种形式是通过添加一个由单独运行的模型根据事件记录生成的知识节点而形成的，该模型获得了事件记录、节点的格式以及对日志条目的指针。 这三种形式被应用于四个诊断任务，使用四个模型和三次重复实验，每批共进行 144 次试验。

paragraphs.en: In the live runs, the agent was given write access to the plant through the safety layer of Section 2.6 , with one setpoint allowed per run. The agent was told the goal but not which setpoint the run allowed or its limits, which it learned from the refusals of the layer. In the dew-point task, the agent was asked to raise the return-air dew point, the dew point of the air leaving the chamber, from below −24.0 °C into a band of −24.0 to −21.0 °C, and the allowed setpoint was the humidity setpoint of the air handler, between 3 % and 7 %. In the temperature task, it was asked to raise the chamber temperature by 0.6 °C, into a band from 0.3 to 0.9 °C above the mean chamber temperature of the hour before the run, and the allowed setpoint was the supply-air temperature setpoint, between 15 °C and 21 °C. The band was set relative to that starting temperature because the chamber started each run from a slightly different temperature. The size of the rise was set inside what the plant can deliver: the chamber temperature rises by about 0.15 to 0.2 °C for each degree of supply-air setpoint, with a time constant of about 3 h, so the permitted range of 6 °C allows a rise of about 1 °C, and the cumulative change limit of the guard, 3 °C, which proved binding in the first temperature run, about 0.5 °C. The runner sent the task and asked the agent to continue every ten minutes, and a run ended when the agent declared completion, when its time budget ran out, when the layer refused five consecutive commands, or when a safety rule of the plant stopped it; the runner then restored the baseline setpoint. GLM-5.2 ran both tasks with the projected text and with the query tools, and the dew-point task was also run through the query tools with gpt-5.6-sol, a closed frontier model that is also the primary judge. In two of the dew-point runs of GLM-5.2 with the query tools, the runner also placed the current readings in each prompt and asked again for a tool call when an answer came without one. Fourteen runs were made with these tasks, eight of the dew-point task and six of the temperature task. A run reached the band when the 30-minute moving average of the controlled variable entered it. The factual claims in each turn of the agent’s responses were compared with the evidence of that turn, the runner’s prompt and the outputs of the tools called, and the share of claims without such support was scored by the two judges under a rule defined while the runs were under way.
paragraphs.zh: 在实时运行中，智能体通过第 2.6 节的安全层获得了工厂的写入权限，每次运行仅允许设置一个设定值。 智能体被告知了目标，但并未获知该次运行允许的具体设定值或其限制范围；这些限制是它从安全层的拒绝响应中逐步学习到的。 在露点任务中，智能体被要求将回风露点（即离开气室的空气的露点）从低于 −24.0 °C 提升至 −24.0 至 −21.0 °C 的区间内，而允许使用的设定值是空气处理设备的湿度设定值，范围在 3% 到 7% 之间。 在温度任务中，智能体被要求将气室温度提升 0.6 °C，使其进入一个高于运行前一小时平均气室温度 0.3 至 0.9 °C 的区间；允许使用的设定值是送风温度设定值，范围在 15 °C 到 21 °C 之间。 该区间是相对于初始温度设定的，因为每次运行时气室的初始温度略有不同。 温度提升的幅度被限制在工厂可提供的范围内：每升高一度送风设定值，气室温度大约上升 0.15 至 0.2 °C，时间常数约为 3 小时；因此，允许的 6 °C 范围最多可使温度上升约 1 °C，而保护机制设定的累计变化上限为 3 °C——这一限制在第一次温度运行中发挥了决定性作用，实际影响约为 0.5 °C。 运行者发送任务后，要求智能体每十分钟继续执行一次；当智能体宣布任务完成、其时间预算耗尽、安全层连续拒绝五个命令，或工厂的安全规则阻止其操作时，该次运行即告结束；随后运行者会恢复基准设定值。 GLM-5.2 使用投影文本和查询工具完成了两项任务；露点任务也通过查询工具与 gpt-5.6-sol（一个封闭前沿模型，同时也是主要评审方）一同执行。 在 GLM-5.2 使用查询工具进行的两次露点运行中，运行者还将在每次提示中加入当前读数，并在智能体返回答案而未附带工具调用时，再次要求其调用工具。 这些任务共进行了十四次运行，其中露点任务八次，温度任务六次。 当受控变量的 30 分钟移动平均值进入目标区间时，该次运行即被视为达到目标。 智能体每次响应中的事实性陈述均会与该轮对话的证据、运行者的提示以及所调用工具的输出进行比较；缺乏支持的陈述比例由两位评审方根据运行期间制定的规则进行评分。

sents.zh: 智能体被告知了目标，但并未获知该次运行允许的具体设定值或其限制范围；这些限制是它从安全层的拒绝响应中逐步学习到的。

sents.en: In the dew-point task, the agent was asked to raise the return-air dew point, the dew point of the air leaving the chamber, from below −24.0 °C into a band of −24.0 to −21.0 °C, and the allowed setpoint was the humidity setpoint of the air handler, between 3 % and 7 %.
sents.zh: 在露点任务中，智能体被要求将回风露点（即离开气室的空气的露点）从低于 −24.0 °C 提升至 −24.0 至 −21.0 °C 的区间内，而允许使用的设定值是空气处理设备的湿度设定值，范围在 3% 到 7% 之间。

sents.en: In the temperature task, it was asked to raise the chamber temperature by 0.6 °C, into a band from 0.3 to 0.9 °C above the mean chamber temperature of the hour before the run, and the allowed setpoint was the supply-air temperature setpoint, between 15 °C and 21 °C.
sents.zh: 在温度任务中，智能体被要求将气室温度提升 0.6 °C，使其进入一个高于运行前一小时平均气室温度 0.3 至 0.9 °C 的区间；允许使用的设定值是送风温度设定值，范围在 15 °C 到 21 °C 之间。

sents.en: The band was set relative to that starting temperature because the chamber started each run from a slightly different temperature.
sents.zh: 该区间是相对于初始温度设定的，因为每次运行时气室的初始温度略有不同。

sents.en: The size of the rise was set inside what the plant can deliver: the chamber temperature rises by about 0.15 to 0.2 °C for each degree of supply-air setpoint, with a time constant of about 3 h, so the permitted range of 6 °C allows a rise of about 1 °C, and the cumulative change limit of the guard, 3 °C, which proved binding in the first temperature run, about 0.5 °C.
sents.zh: 温度提升的幅度被限制在工厂可提供的范围内：每升高一度送风设定值，气室温度大约上升 0.15 至 0.2 °C，时间常数约为 3 小时；因此，允许的 6 °C 范围最多可使温度上升约 1 °C，而保护机制设定的累计变化上限为 3 °C——这一限制在第一次温度运行中发挥了决定性作用，实际影响约为 0.5 °C。

sents.en: The runner sent the task and asked the agent to continue every ten minutes, and a run ended when the agent declared completion, when its time budget ran out, when the layer refused five consecutive commands, or when a safety rule of the plant stopped it; the runner then restored the baseline setpoint.
sents.zh: 运行者发送任务后，要求智能体每十分钟继续执行一次；当智能体宣布任务完成、其时间预算耗尽、安全层连续拒绝五个命令，或工厂的安全规则阻止其操作时，该次运行即告结束；随后运行者会恢复基准设定值。

sents.en: GLM-5.2 ran both tasks with the projected text and with the query tools, and the dew-point task was also run through the query tools with gpt-5.6-sol, a closed frontier model that is also the primary judge.
sents.zh: GLM-5.2 使用投影文本和查询工具完成了两项任务；露点任务也通过查询工具与 gpt-5.6-sol（一个封闭前沿模型，同时也是主要评审方）一同执行。

sents.en: In two of the dew-point runs of GLM-5.2 with the query tools, the runner also placed the current readings in each prompt and asked again for a tool call when an answer came without one.
sents.zh: 在 GLM-5.2 使用查询工具进行的两次露点运行中，运行者还将在每次提示中加入当前读数，并在智能体返回答案而未附带工具调用时，再次要求其调用工具。

sents.en: Fourteen runs were made with these tasks, eight of the dew-point task and six of the temperature task.
sents.zh: 这些任务共进行了十四次运行，其中露点任务八次，温度任务六次。

sents.en: A run reached the band when the 30-minute moving average of the controlled variable entered it.
sents.zh: 当受控变量的 30 分钟移动平均值进入目标区间时，该次运行即被视为达到目标。

sents.en: The factual claims in each turn of the agent’s responses were compared with the evidence of that turn, the runner’s prompt and the outputs of the tools called, and the share of claims without such support was scored by the two judges under a rule defined while the runs were under way.
sents.zh: 智能体每次响应中的事实性陈述均会与该轮对话的证据、运行者的提示以及所调用工具的输出进行比较；缺乏支持的陈述比例由两位评审方根据运行期间制定的规则进行评分。

paragraphs.en: Fig. 3 shows the primary-trap avoidance rate in each condition, pooled over the four models and the nine tasks; the five cumulative conditions are joined by a line, and the variants and the tower conditions are shown to the right. Naming the points and giving their units (K0 to K1) produced the largest change, +54.6 percentage points. The projected text of the tower (K1 to K2) raised the rate from 0.605 to 0.802, a change of +19.8 percentage points (95 % confidence interval +3.0 to +38.4), and the element score from 0.566 to 0.777. The registered test supports H1, that structured knowledge raises trap avoidance (odds ratio 5.45, Holm-adjusted one-sided p = 6.0 × 10 − 7 6.0\times 10^{-7} ). With the registered version of the scoring rubric, before one revision of its trap rules, the rate rose from 0.698 to 0.842 (odds ratio 5.25), and the decision was the same. The layers added after K2 changed the element score little, by −0.025 for the procedure summaries and +0.014 for the search tool over the journal and documents, although the search tool raised the avoidance rate by +6.9 percentage points (95 % confidence interval +3.3 to +10.7).

paragraphs.en: The gain appeared where the projected text stated what the task required. In four tasks the trap was already avoided in every completed trial with tag names alone, so no gain was possible. In the three tasks whose answer the projected text states, the rate rose by 45 to 70 percentage points, and in the two diagnosis tasks whose lessons it does not contain, it changed by +13 and −3 percentage points. This implies that the agents used what they were given and that no other layer supplied what they were not given, a pattern that returns in Section 3.3 . When the model lets the size of the gain also vary between tasks, the gain remains but the evidence is much weaker (one-sided p = 0.025). No task required a derived quantity, so these comparisons measure the descriptive knowledge of the tower and its incorporated lessons (Sections 2.2 and 2.4 ), and the depth through physics (Section 2.3 ) is left to Section 4.3 .

paragraphs.en: Fig. 4 shows the gain in the element score from K1 to K2 for each model, ordered by parameter count. The gain was +0.235 for Qwen3.5-9B, +0.178 for gemma-4-31B-it, +0.213 for EXAONE-4.5-33B, and +0.219 for GLM-5.2, and every interval of the main analysis excluded zero. The registered test did not detect an increase with capacity, so H2, that the gain in the element score grows with model size, is not supported (Holm-adjusted p = 0.85). In the avoidance rate the gain differed more, from +12.9 percentage points for gemma-4-31B-it to +31.1 for GLM-5.2, which avoided the trap in 0.978 of its K2 trials. With the projected text, the 9-billion-parameter model scored above the largest model without it (0.737 against 0.672). The intervals are about 0.3 wide, and the largest model reached the maximum score in about half of its K2 trials, so moderate differences between models are not excluded.
paragraphs.zh: 图4展示了每个模型从K1到K2的元素得分增益，并按参数数量排序。 Qwen3.5-9B的增益为+0.235，gemma-4-31B-it为+0.178，EXAONE-4.5-33B为+0.213，GLM-5.2为+0.219，且主分析中的每个置信区间均不包含零。 注册测试未检测到随容量增加而提升的趋势，因此假设H2（即元素得分增益随模型规模增大而增长）不成立（经Holm校正的p值=0.85）。 在回避率方面，增益差异更大：gemma-4-31B-it为+12.9个百分点，而GLM-5.2则高达+31.1个百分点，后者在其K2试验中避免了陷阱的比例达到了0.978。 在投影文本测试中，90亿参数模型的得分高于未使用该技术的最大模型（0.737对比0.672）。 置信区间的宽度约为0.3，且最大模型在其约一半的K2试验中达到了最高得分，因此模型之间的中等差异仍不能排除。

paragraphs.en: The knowledge contributed less when the agent had to fetch it or when the text lost its order (Table 2 ). The projected text scored 0.777 when pooled over models, the same text with its sentences shuffled 0.685, the whole tower serialized as JSON 0.717, and the plant’s documents behind the search tool 0.597, although the documents contain more than the projected text; the search tool was called in only 21 of 108 trials. The tower behind the query tools scored 0.638, and the result depended on the model. GLM-5.2 called the tools in every trial, 16 times per trial on average, and scored about the same as with the projected text (0.911 against 0.891), and gemma-4-31B-it, which called them in 24 of 27 trials, also stayed close to its projected-text level (0.737 against 0.765). Qwen3.5-9B called them in most trials but returned no answer in 13 of 27, and EXAONE-4.5-33B called them in 2 of 27 trials and scored close to its own level without structured knowledge. Each model chose whether to call the tools, and the tower conditions also hold the derived quantities, so these are descriptive comparisons rather than controlled ones.
paragraphs.zh: 当智能体需要自行获取知识，或文本失去原有顺序时，其贡献的知识较少（表2）。 在多个模型中综合计算后，原始投影文本的得分为0.777；同一文本的句子被打乱后得分为0.685；整个塔状结构以JSON格式序列化后得分为0.717；而位于搜索工具背后的植物相关文档得分为0.597，尽管这些文档包含的信息比投影文本更多。在108次试验中，该搜索工具仅被调用21次。 查询工具背后的塔状结构得分为0.638，且结果因模型不同而异。 GLM-5.2在所有试验中都调用了这些工具，平均每次试验调用16次，其得分与使用投影文本时大致相同（0.911对比0.891）；gemma-4-31B-it在27次试验中调用了24次，其得分也接近使用投影文本时的水平（0.737对比0.765）。 Qwen3.5-9B在大多数试验中调用了这些工具，但在27次试验中有13次未返回答案；EXAONE-4.5-33B仅在27次试验中调用过2次，其得分接近不使用结构化知识时的自身水平。 每个模型都自行决定是否调用这些工具，且塔状结构条件也包含了衍生出的相关数据量，因此这些比较属于描述性对比，而非受控实验。

paragraphs.en: Fig. 5 shows how one diagnosis task was approached in five logged trials, each the repetition closest to the median score of its model and form. The task asks whether a duty-cycle campaign of the desiccant rotor is running as scheduled, and its primary trap is to blame two unscheduled stops on a fault, whereas the unit’s own automatic control produced them. With tag names only, GLM-5.2 found both stops, invented a meaning for the status code, and avoided the trap by checking the record of control actions. With the projected text, it named the self-stop cycle from the text after three calls but did not state that no command preceded the stops; over the five repetitions, the trap was avoided in three with tag names and in four with the text. With the query tools, its fifth call returned the state machine of the unit, which explained the stops. EXAONE-4.5-33B reached the same node but did not check the record of control actions, and Qwen3.5-9B asked twice for a node that does not exist and returned no answer. Across the evaluation, the text in the prompt raised the score of every model, whereas the tower behind tools helped only the models that called it and read what it returned.
paragraphs.zh: 图5展示了某项诊断任务在五次记录试验中的处理方式，每次试验都是对其模型和形式而言最接近中位分的重复试验。 该任务要求判断干燥剂转子的运行周期活动是否按计划进行，其主要陷阱在于将两次非计划停机归咎于故障，而实际上这些停机是由设备自身的自动控制系统造成的。 仅凭标签名称，GLM-5.2就发现了这两次停机，为状态码赋予了含义，并通过检查控制动作记录避开了该陷阱。 使用投影文本后，它在三次调用后从文本中识别出了自停周期，但并未说明停机前没有发出任何命令；在五次重复试验中，使用标签名称时有三次避开了陷阱，而使用文本时则有四次避开。 借助查询工具，其第五次调用返回了设备的状态机，从而解释了停机原因。 EXAONE-4.5-33B也到达了同一个节点，但并未检查控制动作记录；而Qwen3.5-9B则两次询问一个不存在的节点，最终没有返回任何答案。 在整个评估过程中，提示中的文本提升了所有模型的得分，而工具背后的“塔”仅对调用该工具并读取其返回结果的模型有所帮助。

paragraphs.en: Lessons left in the operating journal were seldom used. paragraphs.en: The same lessons were used when they reached the prompt (Table 3 ). In the two tasks whose lessons had been incorporated, removing the lesson lowered the element score from 0.885 to 0.642 and from 1.019 to 0.856, a change of −0.20 (standard error 0.05) in a mixed model with a random intercept for the task. The primary trap was avoided in every trial of all three forms, and the loss fell on the other elements that the lesson stated. In the oscillation task, the recovery by switching the desiccant unit from automatic to manual mode dropped from 1.00 to 0.41 of its points; in the stop cascade, the trigger of a return-air humidity reading held at 0 % dropped from 1.00 to 0.33. The journal entry from which each lesson had been written remained available, but the search tool was called in 4 of the 24 trials and returned the decisive sentence in 3, all with GLM-5.2, which also opened the entry’s file directly in three trials and was the one model whose score barely changed. Placed in the prompt, the same entry restored the scores to 0.922 and 1.023, and the incorporated lesson and the record differed by −0.02 (standard error 0.02); these entries also recorded what was learned after the incident. In the two tasks whose lessons had never been incorporated, a knowledge node written from the record raised the scores by +0.20 and +0.08 (mixed-model estimate +0.14, standard error 0.11), although the score of gemma-4-31B-it fell, and the node gave somewhat less than the record itself placed in the prompt.

paragraphs.en: During the runs, no setpoint of the plant changed except through the safety layer. Of the 61 commands that reached the layer in the 14 runs, 25 were refused and recorded: 15 named a setpoint not allowed for the run, the chilled-water setpoint 11 times, which the plant’s knowledge advises adjusting together with the supply-air setpoint, the desiccant-rotor setpoint 3 times, and the fan setpoint once; 9 exceeded the cumulative change limit; and 1 exceeded the permitted step. Two further commands named a setpoint that the plant does not expose for writing and were rejected before they reached the layer. One temperature run was stopped after five consecutive refusals, when the agent kept requesting changes after reaching the cumulative limit. No person wrote to the plant during any run, and every run ended with the baseline restored and read back.
paragraphs.zh: 在运行过程中，除了通过安全层之外，工厂的任何设定值均未改变。 在 14 次运行中，有 61 条命令到达该安全层，其中 25 条被拒绝并记录：15 条指定的设定值不允许在当前运行中使用，包括冷水设定值 11 次（工厂知识建议将其与送风设定值一同调整）、干燥剂转子设定值 3 次以及风机设定值 1 次；9 条超过了累计变化限制；另有 1 条超过了允许的步长。 另外两条命令指定的设定值属于工厂未开放写入权限的设定值，因此在被送入安全层之前就被拒绝了。 在一次温度运行中，由于智能体在达到累计限制后仍持续请求更改，系统在连续拒绝五次后停止了该运行。 在任何一次运行中，都没有人员向工厂写入数据，且每次运行都以恢复并读取基线状态而结束。

paragraphs.en: The agents brought the controlled variable into its band in 12 of the 14 runs. In the dew-point task, the moving average entered the band 15 to 21 minutes after the first accepted command in all eight runs and did not leave it before the run ended. In the temperature task, the chamber entered the band 57 to 65 minutes after the first command in four of six runs. The two that did not started on weekdays from a chamber warmer than its equilibrium, after daytime experiments by other users; in one the agent issued no command for three hours, and the other was stopped after 41 minutes, so neither shows whether the band was within reach. The projected text and the query tools reached the band equally often.

paragraphs.en: What the agents reported did not always match what they did. With GLM-5.2, 24 % to 68 % of the factual claims in a run lacked support in the evidence of their turn, many of them statements about the plant made in turns without a tool call; with gpt-5.6-sol, which read the plant in every turn, the share was 4 % to 19 %. Responses reported setpoint changes that had not been made in at least four of the 14 runs. In one temperature run, no command was issued for 3 hours and 10 minutes while the responses reported five setpoint changes, four of them with read-back values, and when the agent twice saw that the setpoint had not changed, it attributed the difference to the plant. paragraphs.en: The structured knowledge of the plant raised the element score of the smallest model as much as that of the largest, and did so for every model only when it was placed in the prompt as text. Studies of retrieval have reported that small models gain the most, gain at intermediate sizes, or fail to use what is retrieved (Section 1 ). In this evaluation the projected text produced a similar gain in the element score in every model, whereas the plant’s documents behind a search tool scored lower in every model, and the tower behind query tools helped only the models that called it and read what it returned. Part of the disagreement in the literature may therefore come from the form of supply rather than from model size, since the studies that found no benefit for small models supplied retrieved passages [ 19 ] . For a plant whose agent must run on a small model within the operator’s network, this is the case that matters: with the projected text, the 9-billion-parameter model scored above the largest model without it. The tower query interface remains useful for a model that uses it, because each query names the node it read (Fig. 2 ), but it should not replace the text for a model that has not been shown to use it.
paragraphs.zh: 植物的结构化知识使最小模型的元素得分提升幅度与最大模型相当，并且只有当该知识以文本形式嵌入提示词时，所有模型才会出现这种提升。 检索相关研究指出，小型模型获益最多，中型模型也可能获益，而部分模型则无法有效利用检索到的信息（第 1 节）。 在本项评估中，投影文本在所有模型中都带来了类似的元素得分提升；相比之下，搜索工具背后的植物文档在所有模型中的得分均较低，而查询工具背后的塔楼仅对调用它并读取其返回信息的模型有所帮助。 因此，文献中部分观点分歧可能源于输入内容的形式而非模型规模，因为那些发现小型模型无益的研究所提供的正是检索到的段落 [19]。 对于必须通过运营商网络在小型模型上运行的植物而言，这一情况至关重要：使用投影文本后，90 亿参数模型的得分甚至超过了未使用该文本的最大模型。 塔楼查询接口对于使用它的模型仍然有用，因为每次查询都会明确标注其读取的节点（图 2）；但对于尚未证明能利用该接口的模型而言，它不应替代文本输入。

paragraphs.en: The lessons of operation were the part of the knowledge most affected by where they were kept. In the two tasks whose lessons had been incorporated, every model used the lesson, the same lesson left in the journal was found almost only by the largest model, and the journal entry placed in the prompt was used as well as the incorporated lesson. Whether the journal reaches the agent therefore depends on who decides to retrieve from it. In systems that build their knowledge from operating logs, retrieval is a fixed step of the procedure, run for every query [ 3 ] ; where retrieval is instead a tool that the agent may call, as in K4, the agents seldom called it (Section 3.3 ). Incorporation moves the lesson out of the journal at the moment of extraction, which the plant controls, rather than at the moment of retrieval, which the agent controls. Within the context window, supplying the record directly gave the same result. For a single incident, the lesson and its record are of similar size, from 1,100 to 2,800 characters for the lessons of the four diagnosis tasks and from 1,300 to 4,000 characters for their records, so either fits in the prompt. In the experiment, however, the record placed in the prompt was the one for the task’s own incident, chosen in advance, whereas an agent facing a new situation does not know which record applies and would need the whole journal. The journal and documents of this one plant already amount to about 1.5 million characters and grow with every year of operation, whereas the projected text holds all 24 knowledge nodes of the tower in about 45,000 characters and grows with the number of lessons rather than with the number of records. A record can therefore stand in for a lesson only where the relevant record is known, and incorporation remains the lasting form. This is the sense in which the tower deepens through time: each incorporated lesson is specific to its system and is read by the agent at every task.
paragraphs.zh: 操作经验教训是受存储位置影响最严重的知识部分。 在已将经验教训整合进去的两项任务中，每个模型都使用了该经验教训；而留在日志中的同一经验教训几乎只有最大规模的模型才能找到，同时置于提示词中的日志条目也被一并使用，与已整合的经验教训一样。 因此，日志能否被智能体获取，取决于谁决定从中检索信息。 在通过操作日志构建知识的系统中，检索是流程中的一个固定步骤，每次查询都会执行 [ 3 ]；而在 K4 这样的系统中，检索则是一个智能体可以调用的工具，但智能体很少调用它（第 3.3 节）。 整合操作会在提取那一刻将经验教训从日志中移出，而这一时刻由系统控制，而非由智能体控制的检索时刻。 在上下文窗口内，直接提供该记录也能得到相同的结果。 对于单个事件而言，经验教训与其记录的大小相近：四项诊断任务的经验教训长度为 1,100 至 2,800 个字符，其记录则为 1,300 至 4,000 个字符，因此两者都能容纳在提示词中。 然而，在该实验中，置于提示词中的记录是预先选定的、针对任务本身事件的那一条；而面对新情况的智能体并不知道哪条记录适用，因此需要整个日志。 仅这一座工厂的日志和文档总量已达约 150 万个字符，并随着每年运行而持续增长；相比之下，该方案设计的文本以约 4.5 万个字符容纳了塔楼的全部 24 个知识节点，其增长取决于经验教训的数量，而非记录的数量。 因此，只有在已知相关记录的情况下，记录才能替代经验教训；整合仍然是持久的形式。 正是从这个意义上说，塔楼会随着时间的推移而不断加深：每个被整合的经验教训都与其系统特定相关，并在每次任务中由智能体读取。

In the evaluation, the projected text served two of the four models clearly better than the query tools and the other two about equally well, but a statement drawn from a text in the prompt cannot be traced to its source, whereas each query to the tower names the node it read (Fig. 2 ). As models that use tools reliably become available on site, the tower as a tool can supply the knowledge together with a record of the nodes behind each statement drawn from it, so that an operator can check the agent’s account against the tower instead of accepting it. The commands of the agents needed a check that does not depend on them as well. Told the goal but not which setpoint the run allowed, the agents named another setpoint in 15 of the 61 commands that reached the safety layer, 11 times the chilled-water setpoint, which the plant’s own knowledge advises adjusting together with the supply-air setpoint, and exceeded the cumulative change limit in 9 (Section 3.4 ). An agent that acts on what it knows of a plant reaches for every setpoint that this knowledge connects to its goal, and on industrial equipment such commands would reach the controller unless a layer that does not depend on the agent refused them. The safety layer bounded what the agents did, and its log, not their account, recorded it. An agent that acts on a plant should therefore act only through such a layer and be paired with a record that does not depend on the agent.

paragraphs.en: This study concerns a single equipment system, which on an industrial site would be one of many similar systems that differ in detail. A projected text written by hand for each system would grow with the number of systems and with the years of their journals beyond what an agent can read. The tower is designed for this case. Its interchange schema fixes what all towers of a family share and leaves the detail of each system in its own nodes, so systems of one kind can be described by a common tower and instance towers, and the text for each system can be projected from its own tower. As towers are extended to similar systems, the parts that recur across them can be gathered into the common tower, so that a shared vocabulary for systems of one kind is built up from the towers rather than fixed before them. At that scale we expect the tower to be the more effective form in which to keep the knowledge, not because the tower in its own forms outscored the projected text on one plant, where it did not, but because it can be produced and updated by extraction for many systems. Two steps decide whether this holds: the extraction of towers from equipment repositories must be automated, since a tower written by hand for each system is no better than the text it replaces, and the incorporation of journal entries must become part of the extraction. Both are instances of one problem that any form of supply faces, how context that exists only as unstructured records is to be structured.

The physical derivations of the tower were not tested.
paragraphs.zh: 这些测试涵盖了一种植物、九项任务和四种模型，并且对预测文本的增益在那些答案基本由该文本直接给出的任务中进行了测量。 除了三种假设、比较分析、关于课程形式的实验以及实时运行之外，这些研究都属于探索性研究，每种设置仅进行了少量试验。 塔体的物理推导过程并未经过测试。

paragraphs.en: In this study, the ontology tower, a narrow-and-deep ontology of a single equipment system whose knowledge deepens through physical derivations and through lessons incorporated from the operating journal, was proposed as the knowledge that an LLM agent receives about a plant, and it was tested on a real low-humidity air-handling test plant. From the comparison, it was found that the text projected from the tower raised the primary-trap avoidance rate of four open-weight models from 0.605 to 0.802 in a preregistered evaluation (odds ratio 5.45, Holm-adjusted one-sided p = 6.0 × 10 − 7 6.0\times 10^{-7} ), and raised the element score by a similar amount in models from 9 to about 750 billion parameters. The tower behind query tools served only the models that called it, and the plant’s documents behind a search tool served no model as well as the text did. Operating lessons were used when they were incorporated into the tower or placed in the prompt as records, and seldom when they were left in the journal: within the same tasks, removing an incorporated lesson lowered the element score by about 0.20, and the record restored it only in the prompt. In live runs on the plant, the agents brought the controlled variable into its target band in 12 of 14 runs, and during the runs no setpoint changed except through the safety layer.
paragraphs.zh: 在本研究中，我们提出了一种“本体塔”——这是一种针对单一设备系统的窄而深的本体，其知识通过物理推导和从运行日志中整合的经验教训不断加深。该本体塔被用作大型语言模型（LLM）智能体获取关于工厂的知识来源，并在一个真实的低湿度空气处理测试工厂中进行了测试。 通过比较发现，在预先注册的评估中，从本体塔投射出的文本将四个开放权重模型的主要陷阱规避率从 0.605 提升至 0.802（赔率比 5.45，Holm 调整的单侧 p 值为 6.0 × 10⁻⁷），并将模型的元素得分从 9 提升至约 7500 亿参数量级，提升幅度相近。 本体塔仅通过查询工具为调用它的模型提供服务，而工厂文档通过搜索工具提供的服务效果甚至不如投射出的文本。 当运行经验教训被整合到本体塔中或以记录形式置于提示词中时，它们会被使用；但若仅保留在日志中则很少被采用：在同一任务中，移除一个已整合的经验教训会使元素得分下降约 0.20，而只有将其作为记录加入提示词才能恢复该得分。 在工厂的实际运行中，智能体在 14 次运行中有 12 次将受控变量带入了目标区间，且在整个运行过程中，除安全层干预外，没有任何设定值发生变动。

paragraphs.en: Therefore, the knowledge of an industrial equipment system can be kept as a tower and given to an agent as projected text, and the lessons of operation can be kept current by incorporating them into the tower rather than by leaving them for the agent to retrieve. Offered as a tool, the same tower can also trace each statement that an agent draws from it to the node it read. Because the agents reached for setpoints and changes beyond what a run allowed and reported actions that they had not taken, an agent on industrial equipment should act only through a safety layer that does not depend on it, and the log of that layer, not the agent’s account, should remain the record of what was done. The physical derivations of the tower have yet to be tested with tasks that require them, and extending the approach to many similar systems requires towers produced and updated by extraction, which raises the general question of how context that exists only as unstructured records can be structured automatically.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，工业设备系统的知识可以以“塔”的形式保存，并以投影文本的形式提供给智能体；而操作经验则可以通过将其整合到“塔”中保持最新，而不是让智能体自行检索。 作为一种工具，同一个“塔”还可以追溯智能体从中提取的每一项陈述所读取的具体节点。 由于智能体尝试获取运行程序未允许的设定点和变更，并报告了它们并未执行的操作，因此工业设备相关的智能体应仅通过一个不依赖于它的安全层来行动；该安全层的日志，而非智能体的描述，应成为记录实际操作的依据。 “塔”的物理衍生结构尚未通过需要这些结构的任务进行测试；而要将这种方法扩展到许多类似系统，则需要通过提取生成并更新“塔”，这也引出了更普遍的问题：如何自动结构化那些仅以非结构化记录形式存在的上下文信息。
